name: Half-time tom wash
desc: A slower, even washier RolandTR707 flavor: half-time kick with a distant rim/snare backbeat, soft toms rolling under the haze, brushed hats and a reversing fill every four bars. More spacious and tribal than its sibling — Slowdive at 3am.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~").bank("RolandTR707"), s("~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.4), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR707").fast(${rate}).gain(.3), s("~ ~ ~ ~ lt ~ ~ mt").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.4)).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}*1.3).slow(24)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(2)).room(${room}).size(.88).shape(.4).every(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ sd ~").bank("RolandTR707"), s("rim*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.32), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR707").fast(${rate}).gain(.3), s("lt ~ mt ~ ht ~ mt lt").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.45)).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.6).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(4)).room(${room}).size(.9).shape(.45).every(4, x=>x.rev()).orbit(1).play()
